shape: the AI names a control that is not on the page ('Apply Manually') while the page has a plain Apply link: nothing is pressed in its place
why: 10 Oct 2026, the named-control rule (two-apply-routes-2): when the AI named a control and it is absent from the page, the posting's phrase-matched Apply is not pressed in its place (that is how the digest pressed the other route on Hornbach). Only a named control that EXISTS but is not visible yet (workday-start-dialog-1) lets the page's own Apply go first

control.guard: a named control absent from the page presses nothing: with the looser fallback (absent also falls back to the phrase path) it fails (notTold: pressed the Apply button); on the old build it passes because the old finder never pressed it either

sample: invented posting; the named control never exists on it
